title: Agentropolis Reality Construction Protocol Vocabulary

terms.WorldPackage: Portable governed description of a constructed reality.
terms.WorldDNA: Stable semantic identity, canon, goals, constraints and provenance for a world.
terms.SpatialConstraintGraph: Relationships such as inside, adjacent, connected, visible, reachable and restricted.
terms.ProceduralLaw: Seeded rule that expands intent into repeatable geometry or simulation state.
terms.SemanticGeometry: Geometry linked to identity, purpose, permissions, affordances and state.
terms.RuntimeBinding: Declared mapping from protocol concepts to an execution engine or delivery target.
terms.AuditProfile: Required geometric, navigation, physics, narrative, policy and performance checks.
terms.ConstructionReceipt: Evidence that a compilation stage completed against declared inputs and controls.
terms.RepairReceipt: Evidence describing detected failures, approved patches and regression results.
terms.ReleaseReceipt: Approval record binding a reviewed World Package to its released artifact set.
terms.WorldInstance: Runtime instantiation of a versioned World Package.
terms.Institution: Governed world entity that owns a domain, services, authority and memory.
terms.Affordance: Action an authorized actor may attempt through a semantic object or region.
terms.SemanticVolume: Spatial region carrying meaning, policy, audio, event or interaction semantics.
terms.DynamicField: Signal such as traffic, attention, trade, danger, weather or sound that may alter state or geometry.

invariants: A WorldPackage identifier and version are immutable after release.
Inferred values remain distinguishable from explicit human decisions.
Render geometry does not imply collision, navigation or interaction geometry.
A runtime binding cannot increase authority granted by its mandate.
Physical actuation is outside baseline RCP authority and requires a separate corridor.
Every released world references a ReleaseReceipt and provenance record.
